lines.quote: Phased-array beamforming: developed per-element gain and phase calibration routines for Sumuvire's 12-element 400 MHz receive array, including scan-angle-dependent weight tables and automated gain-error correction
Wrote the embedded C firmware for the KW-200 digital front end on a Xilinx Zynq platform, implementing a four-channel digital downconverter with configurable decimation and filter coefficients

Developed and maintained the production Python test automation suite for the Oulu hardware lab: automated regression testing of receiver firmware builds, nightly performance benchmarks, and calibration data archival (~8k lines, NumPy/SciPy stack, PostgreSQL backend)

Measured receiver noise figure, gain flatness, and third-order intercept point across the 100-500 MHz band for the full KW-200 production run using a Rohde & Schwarz FSW spectrum analyser and Keysight N5182B signal generator
Coordinated a four-person engineering team migrating the KW-200 signal chain to a new hardware platform, covering sprint planning, hardware resource allocation, and integration test scheduling
That migration was my first time formally running a project rather than contributing as an individual
